summary.zh-TW: 按下「加入購物車」，商品方塊會沿著一條弧線飛進右上角的購物車，抵達後數字加一、購物車彈一下。虛線就是飛行路徑。
summary.en: Press “Add to cart” and a product square flies along an arc into the cart at the top right; when it lands the count goes up and the cart bounces. The dashed line is the flight path.

text.zh-TW: 讓元素沿著一條路徑移動，而不是直直地從 A 到 B。路徑可以是 SVG 的 path，也可以是一串座標點。
text.en: Moves an element along a path instead of straight from A to B. The path can be an SVG path or a list of points.

text.zh-TW: 用三個點（起點、拱起的中間點、終點）自動產生一條平滑曲線，再轉成 SVG 的 d 屬性畫出虛線。視窗大小改變時會重畫。
text.en: Builds a smooth curve from three points (start, raised midpoint, end), then converts it to an SVG d attribute to draw the dashed line. Redrawn when the window resizes.

text.zh-TW: 曲線的圓滑程度：0 是折線，1～2 越來越圓。改 ARC 可以讓弧線拱得更高或更低。
text.en: How round the curve is: 0 is straight segments, 1–2 gets rounder. Change ARC to raise or lower the arc.

text.zh-TW: align 把元素對齊到路徑的座標系統；alignOrigin 決定元素的哪一點貼著路徑走，[0.5, 0.5] 是中心點。
text.en: align maps the element onto the path’s coordinate system; alignOrigin sets which point of the element follows the path — [0.5, 0.5] is the centre.

text.zh-TW: 每次點擊都複製一個新的方塊來飛，飛完就移除。所以連續點很多下，也會一個接一個飛進購物車。
text.en: Each click clones a fresh square to fly and removes it on arrival, so rapid clicks send them into the cart one after another.
